newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rotterdam bunkers unchanged, Med steady to firm.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam bunkers unchanged, Med steady to firm.

text.p: Rotterdam bunkers were steady in moderate demand on Wednesday, while some quotes in the Mediterranean rose, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 CST fuel oil bunkers were quoted at around $91/$92 fob as barges again traded in the range $89-$90 ex-wharf.
Total ARA trading volume was reasonable, at between 10,000 and 20,000 tonnes.
Hamburg prices increased in response to Tuesday's Rotterdam rise. Supply of 380 CST fuel oil was reasonably short. Demand remained low.
Mediterranean fuel oil prices were steady to firm. Demand in a number of ports increased.
Saudi Aramco upped Red Sea prices -- by $1 to $97 on fuel and by $3 to $183 on diesel -- while keeping Gulf fuel oil steady at $101 and lowering diesel there by $2 to $194.
